subject: PrivDeploy anchoring & support flex-path
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.p@orionhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Jensen <ljensen@orionhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: PrivDeploy packaging & support inquiry

Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Orion is evaluating a private deployment (VPC) for a pilot next quarter and we need to lock down commercial packaging before we scope the PoC. A few specific asks we want to confirm up front: 

- Platform fee: are you able to amortize the platform fee monthly vs a single upfront invoice? Our finance team prefers monthly amortization if possible.
- Migration assistance: can Redwood provide a migration credit (one-time) to offset part of integration/onboarding cost? If so, what range do you typically offer for a customer this size?
- Support tiers: we need clarity on SRE/oncall retainer vs per-incident rates. Also interested in a reduced-rate bundle for 24x7 coverage during the pilot ramp.
- Licensing: we are leaning toward operator licenses + per-site node floor — any flexibility on operator counts for the pilot?

I attached our short RFP. Can you put together a brief commercial sketch (numbers + a suggested support bundle) so we can share with procurement?

Appreciate it,
Samir
Procurement | Orion Health Systems
procurement@orionhealth.com

Attachment: orion-rfp-privdeploy.pdf (stub)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy packaging & support inquiry

Samir — thanks for the RFP and the clear list. High level answers and a proposed starter commercial sketch below; I put Marissa on the thread to confirm support SLAs and amortization mechanics. Neha will be on the follow-up for finance if we need to convert to a commit.

Quick answers: 
- Platform fee: yes — we can amortize the platform fee monthly for accounting. Typical full-year platform fee for deployments at your initial scale is $150,000/yr. We can offer: (A) prepaid annual invoice, or (B) amortized monthly at $12,500/mo billed monthly.
- Migration assistance: we can provide a one-time migration credit up to 12% of the first-year platform fee (standard) or a fixed $50k credit, whichever is lower, as a trade for a 12-month minimum commercial commitment.
- Support tiers: three options — Standard (business hours, included), SRE retainer (40 hrs/mo, $20k/mo), SRE+24x7 (dedicated after-hours rotation, $35k/mo). Per-incident ad hoc is $450/hr outside retained hours. For pilots we frequently offer a reduced retainer at 50% for the first month.
- Licensing flexibility: operator licenses can be pooled; for the pilot we can lower operator count by up to 30% for the first 90 days with operator seat reassignment on conversion.

Pilot concession (proposal):
- Pilot month: first month free of platform fee (pilot-only),
- Migration: $50,000 migration credit applied to SOW or first invoice,
- Support: 50% discount on SRE retainer for first 30 days (if committed),
- SLA: baseline 99.95% for production; pilot has target 99.9% with defined monitoring handoffs.

I've attached a short term sheet and SOW stub (redwood-privdeploy-term-sheet-v3.pdf, SOW-draft-orion-privdeploy-2026.docx). If this aligns we can run a quick scoping call tomorrow to adjust operator counts and finalize DocuSign.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Commercial Solutions | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-privdeploy-term-sheet-v3.pdf (stub); SOW-draft-orion-privdeploy-2026.docx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@orionhealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy packaging & support inquiry

Samir — quick follow-up from an ops/support perspective. Echoing Diego's high-level commercials but want to flag a couple of practicals so expectations are aligned: 

- Migration credit application: we typically apply credit against the SOW (professional services) rather than platform invoice to keep run-rate clean. If your team prefers invoice credit we can do that but it requires a bundled invoice schedule.
- Observability addon: the console observability retention add-on is licensed separately. For pilot purposes we can include 30 days of extended retention at no charge to support root-cause analysis.
- Onboarding SRE time: the $50k credit typically covers ~200 engineer-hours of professional services. For the pilot concession we can guarantee 80 onboarding hours plus two-week hypercare.

If Orion needs billing spread longer than 12 months we'll involve finance — Neha is looped here to confirm how far we can stretch amortization without a revenue deferral issue.

Marissa
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Samir Patel <samir.p@orionhealth.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Jensen <ljensen@orionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy packaging & support inquiry

Diego/Marissa — thanks for the detailed sketch. A couple of counterpoints from procurement/finance: 

- Migration credit: our preference is a single invoice credit against the first platform invoice (keeps vendor accounting simple). We'd ask for 15% of first-year platform fee (vs your 12% offer).
- Pilot month: would like the pilot month to be treated as a true trial (no platform fee and no obligation) — if we convert within 90 days we pay retroactively for weeks used.
- SRE hours: can you commit 100 onboarding hours for the pilot (instead of 80)? That will help our engineering team shorten the integration window.

If you can accept 15% credit and 100 hours, procurement will greenlight a one-page MSA and we can route for DocuSign.

Samir
Procurement | Orion Health Systems

(Quoted)
> On Mon, 25 May 2026 at 09:03 Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Samir — thanks for the RFP...

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Jensen <ljensen@orionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy packaging & support inquiry

Samir — appreciate the clarity and the ask. We can meet you partway so you can get procurement momentum: 

- Migration credit: we'll increase to 13.5% of the first-year platform fee (equates to $20,250 on a $150k base) and provide an additional fixed onboarding services block so net assistance is closer to your ask. Alternatively, we can do a flat $50k credit as Diego proposed earlier (your choice).
- Onboarding hours: we can commit to 100 hours for the pilot (guaranteed), plus two-week hypercare.
- Pilot month: we can make the pilot month fee-free and include an option to retroactively bill pro rata upon conversion within 90 days — that keeps the trial clean for you and preserves contract integrity for us.

Next steps: I'll update the term sheet to show (A) monthly amortization at $12,500/mo, (B) migration credit option (13.5% vs $50k), (C) 100 guaranteed onboarding hours + two weeks hypercare, (D) pilot month waived with 90-day retro billing option. Marissa/Neha — any issues from your side on the amended language?

If this aligns, Samir, we can have a revised one-page commercial term sheet and send for DocuSign before COB tomorrow.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Commercial Solutions | Redwood Inference

(Attachment: revised redwood-privdeploy-term-sheet-v3.pdf to follow)
